svg.text: Rows 1–63 left→right, columns a–j top→bottom. U1 = QFP64→DIP64 900-mil adapter (pins in a/h), raised on stacked headers; holes under it are wired first. Wire numbers match BREADBOARD.md.
pin 1 at row 1 col a · raise it on stacked headers
Rails assumed continuous over all 63 rows — if yours are split in the middle, bridge each rail. Resistors R1–R24 and C1–C3 go from the marked strip to the rail.
